parts.name: Lower Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the lower cabinet door of the tall storage cabinet, made of MDF with a smooth finish.
parts.Functional_description: It covers and provides access to the lower storage compartment, typically opened by pulling a handle.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Upper Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the upper cabinet door of the tall storage cabinet, made of MDF with a similar finish to the lower door.
parts.Functional_description: It conceals the upper storage compartment and allows access when opened.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Upper Shelf
parts.Basic_description: This is the upper internal shelf of the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items within the upper compartment, dividing the space for organization.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the tall storage cabinet, made of plywood for strength and stability.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and houses all other components such as doors and shelves.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving structure.

parts.name: Lower Shelf
parts.Basic_description: This is the lower internal shelf of the cabinet, made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It supports items stored in the lower compartment, providing a flat surface for organization.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during normal use.
